name: AITopTools

sources.title: Submit/Claim page — 2-step flow: enter tool URL + email → AI generates listing draft; fields include category, logo ≤5MB, 300-char short desc, 10k-char description, 3 use cases, pricing model
FAQ — 'our team will review it, usually within a few days. Paid options are available for faster approval' (via search snippet)
Submitator writeup — $59 one-time publish ($99 struck through), $9.99/mo alt, $299 tier adds 100+ directory submissions; dofollow verified on 400 sampled listings
Refund Policy — paid listings are final once published; refund only within 3 days if they reject before publication (via search snippet)

requirements: AI tools only — large AI-tool directory (11k+ listings, self-claimed DR 54-55)
Publishing is paid: $59 one-time (also offered as $9.99/mo); $299 tier adds done-for-you submission to 100+ other directories; $49 newsletter add-on; $628/mo recurring featured placement
Two-step flow: enter tool URL + email → AI builds a draft → review/edit → pick publish option (price revealed at the final step)
Listing fields: name, category (huge taxonomy), logo/screenshot (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF ≤5MB, square best), short description ≤300 chars, full description ≤10k chars, 3 use cases, pricing model
preparation: ≤300-char tagline + up to 10k-char description with practical use-case examples
Budget: $59 one-time for the base listing
workflow: Enter tool URL + email → 'Create My Listing' generates an AI draft
Review/edit the listing (name, category, logo, descriptions, use cases, pricing)
Choose publish option at the final step ($59 one-time or $9.99/mo; optional upgrades)
Standard review 2-5 business days per FAQ; paid featured reviewed within 24h
watchFor: Price only appears at the last step — don't assume free despite FAQ's vague 'review within a few days'
$299 bundle covers their listing + 100 unnamed directories (list disclosed after payment) — a competitor (Submitator) wrote this up; evaluate skeptically
Once a paid listing is published, sale is final — refund only within 3 days of a pre-publication rejection
Owner entity: MK INTERNET INVESTMENTS LLC (Florida); cancellations via email to michael@aitoptools.com
Listing includes a dashboard for views + review management and an X announcement — perks beyond a backlink
countsAsLive: The tool has a public aitoptools.com listing page (canonical, followed link to your site) browsable under its category and 'New Additions'
unknowns: Whether a genuinely free publish option exists behind step 2 (FAQ hints at review without payment, Submitator says publishing costs $59)
Whether the free/lower tiers get the same dofollow link treatment as paid
